summary: Detailed analysis and implementation plan for: (1) Scalable chunk map editor with adjustable chunk size (kr) and map capacity (max chunks), (2) Standard player mechanics (equip/unequip, consumables in turn-based vs free-test modes), (3) Defeat handling without auto-reset (revive vs respawn vs reset), (4) GM Combat Hack / Match Editor popup in Balance Analytics, and (5) 3D dice performance optimizations (texture caching, zero-GC physics loop, throttled shadow rendering).
